parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH base AS (
  SELECT id, name, amount, currency, due_day, owner, status,
    date('now', 'localtime') AS today
  FROM bills WHERE status = 'unpaid'
),
step1 AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%d', today) AS INTEGER) <= due_day
      THEN date(today, 'start of month')
      ELSE date(today, 'start of month', '+1 month') END AS month_start
  FROM base
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT *, CAST(strftime('%d', date(month_start, '+1 month', '-1 day')) AS INTEGER) AS last_day
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT *, MIN(due_day, last_day) AS clamped_day FROM step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT *, date(month_start, '+' || (clamped_day - 1) || ' days') AS due_date FROM step3
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS bill_count,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      '• ' || name || ' — ' || printf('%.2f', amount) || ' ' || currency
        || ' — due ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec',
             CAST(strftime('%m', due_date) AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 3)
        || ' ' || strftime('%d', due_date),
      char(10) ORDER BY due_date
    ) AS bill_list
  FROM step4
)
SELECT
  '**Monthly Overview — ' ||
  CASE CAST(strftime('%m', 'now') AS INTEGER)
    WHEN 1 THEN 'January'   WHEN 2 THEN 'February' WHEN 3 THEN 'March'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'April'     WHEN 5 THEN 'May'      WHEN 6 THEN 'June'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'July'      WHEN 8 THEN 'August'   WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'October'  WHEN 11 THEN 'November' WHEN 12 THEN 'December'
  END || ' ' || strftime('%Y', 'now') || '**' || char(10) ||
  '**Total:** ' || printf('%.2f', total_amount) || ' EUR across ' ||
  bill_count || ' bills' || char(10) || char(10) ||
  bill_list AS message
FROM summary
);
